analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 31.3 continues in oversold territory. MACD histogram at -3.0218 shows worsening momentum. 5-day low of $320.18 confirms a Lower Low pattern against the 20-day low of $320.18. Volume ratio of 0.58 indicates subdued buying interest. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($320.21) vs SMA5 ($332.73)/SMA20 ($343.08)/SMA50 ($342.88): Below, confirming short-to-medium term bearish trend position.
· Below SMA100 ($348.40)/SMA200 ($340.99): Maintaining strong mid-to-long term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (42.3%) + Approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.5 → 31.3): Continues in oversold territory, bearish momentum dominance.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1740 → -3.0218): Continues worsening, signaling strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $326.07): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($319.35): Close to 5-day low, testing key support level.
· Swing resistance ($328.83): First resistance level on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): Continued weakness, suggesting potential for further downside.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58x): Subdued buying interest, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Maintain wait-and-see, confirmation needed at support level and for bounce potential.
